title: Adaptive-Group Process Rewards for GUI Agents
abstract: arXiv:2610.17710v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Training graphical user interface (GUI) agents with reinforcement learning suffers from sparse outcome rewards, leading to inefficient learning. Process rewards offer a promising direction for credit assignment to intermediate actions; however, accurately evaluating an action requires identifying evidence across long-horizon GUI trajectories, as its value may depend on information beyond its immediate state and observation. In this paper, we propose an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions a GUI trajectory into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both the action and group levels. At the action level, a critic evaluates each action based on the visual changes and subsequent actions within the group for action correctness and contribution to the subgoal. translated_title: 面向GUI智能体的自适应分组过程奖励
translated_abstract: arXiv:2610.17710v1 公告类型：新论文 摘要：使用强化学习训练图形用户界面（GUI）智能体面临结果奖励稀疏的问题，导致学习效率低下。过程奖励为中间动作的信用分配提供了一个有前景的方向；然而，准确评估一个动作需要在长时程的GUI轨迹中识别证据，因为其价值可能依赖于超出其当前状态和观察范围的信息。在本文中，我们提出了一种自适应分组过程奖励框架，该框架能够动态地将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组，从而在动作和组两个层面进行过程奖励估计。在动作层面，评论家模型根据组内的视觉变化和后续动作来评估每个动作的正确性及其对子目标的贡献。在组层面，该框架汇总动作层面的评估结果，以评估子目标的完成情况及其对（最终目标的）贡献。
tldr: 提出了一种自适应分组过程奖励框架，通过动态将GUI轨迹划分为语义连贯的子目标组，在动作和组两个层面进行过程奖励估计，解决了GUI智能体强化学习训练中奖励稀疏和中间动作信用分配困难的问题。
en_tdlr: Proposes an adaptive-group process reward framework that dynamically partitions GUI trajectories into semantically coherent subgoal groups, enabling process reward estimation at both action and group levels to address the sparse reward and credit assignment challenges in reinforcement learning training of GUI agents.
